author: Unity
description:
Watch this video to learn about how the UI Toolkit Event System works in Unity 6 and how it differs from UGUI. We’ll take a look at the Trickle-Down, Target, and Bubble-Up propagation phases. You’ll see how to handle clicks, drags, hovers, and focus using pointer and keyboard events, and how to code callbacks with RegisterCallback and UnregisterCallback for responsive logic.

More resources:

If you are getting started with UI Toolkit, make sure to check out the following resources:
